name: Prandia
tagline: Institutional-grade ghost kitchen infrastructure for the independent operator.
positioning: Prandia provisions licensed commissary capacity, delivery integrations, and menu operations so individuals can launch delivery-only food brands without a lease.

hero.h1: Launch a delivery-only food brand without signing a lease.
hero.sub: Prandia allocates on-demand commissary capacity, unifies your delivery marketplace listings, and standardizes fulfillment—so a single operator can run a professional kitchen from day one.

features.title: Commissary Allocation
features.description: Reserve certified kitchen stations by the hour across our metro network, with cold storage and equipment provisioned to your menu spec.

features.title: Unified Marketplace Sync
features.description: Publish one menu to every delivery marketplace at once. Prandia reconciles pricing, hours, and item availability across channels automatically.

features.title: Margin Intelligence
features.description: Line-item costing on every order. See contribution margin per SKU and per channel before marketplace commissions erode your take-home.

features.title: Compliance Custody
features.description: We hold your food-safety certifications, permit filings, and inspection records in a single audit-ready ledger.

features.title: Fulfillment SLAs
features.description: Ticket routing and prep timers keep every order inside marketplace promise windows, protecting your operator rating.

features.title: Demand Forecasting
features.description: Prep quantities recommended nightly from trailing order velocity, reducing spoilage on perishable inventory.

testimonials.quote: I run two virtual brands out of a single Prandia station on nights and weekends. My marketplace listings, prep sheets, and margins all reconcile in one console—I never touch a spreadsheet.
testimonials.name: Marcus Devlin

testimonials.quote: Before Prandia I was manually copying menu changes into three delivery apps. Now one edit propagates everywhere, and the compliance ledger passed my county inspection on the first visit.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: The margin intelligence dashboard flagged two items as unprofitable after commissions. I repriced overnight and my weekly take-home climbed eighteen percent.
testimonials.name: Devon Alcott
